items.why: Nvidia soars 30% as the board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO, and chip stocks are jumping with it.
The Nasdaq roars back by 6% and the S&P 500 rebounds 4%, so the fear gauge is collapsing as stocks recover.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.
The Nasdaq roars back by 6% as Nvidia soars on Huang's return, with the S&P 500 rebounding 4%.

market_note: Nasdaq futures up 7.12% and the VIX down 25.24% into the close.
summary: Stocks are roaring back in a sharp relief rally, led by Nvidia on Jensen Huang's return as CEO. The Nasdaq is up about 7% and the S&P 500 up about 5% as buyers step back in after the slide.
